meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可经 Chat SDK 接入微软 Teams,在团队频道、群聊、私聊中聊天,并主动给你发消息;它会自动复制适配器、装依赖、构建测试,再引导你登录、创建机器人、配置凭据。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 Claude 或 NanoClaw 添加微软 Teams 频道、集成 Teams 聊天,或需要配置 Teams 机器人并连接自己账号时触发。

say.text: 帮我接入微软 Teams 聊天
say.note: 启动 add-teams 技能,自动开始配置。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加 Teams 频道支持
say.note: 触发相同流程,包括创建机器人和安装应用。

say.text: 配置 Teams 机器人并连接我的账号
say.note: 引导完成登录、创建应用和安装到 Teams。

howto.what_en: Claude gains Microsoft Teams chat via Chat SDK (team channels, group chats, DMs) and can initiate messages. It copies the adapter, installs deps, builds/tests, then guides login, bot creation, credentials, and app install.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add Microsoft Teams channel/integration to Claude or NanoClaw, or wants to set up a Teams bot linked to their account.

say_en.text: Integrate Microsoft Teams chat for me
say_en.note: Starts the add-teams skill and setup flow.

say_en.text: Add Teams channel support to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Runs the same flow, including bot creation and app install.

say_en.text: Set up a Teams bot and link my account
say_en.note: Guides through login, app creation, and installation.
